tools.description: Creates a new merchant with the authenticated account. You MUST ask the user to provide the required information for merchant creation. One of the required fields is the Merchant Category Code (MCC). Since the list of MCCs is long, you may present a subset of common options, but you MUST inform the user that more options are available and they can ask for the full list (e.g. by showing "X more options" or similar hint). Additionally, inform the user that they can directly provide the 4-digit MCC code (e.g., 5499) if they already know it, and encourage them to use it. Do not call this tool until you have attempted to collect the required information for merchant creation. After the merchant is created, you MUST present the Business Console Terms of Service URL to the user and instruct them to accept it before they can perform any operations on this merchant.

tools.description: Sets the role of a principal (user) on a merchant, or adds a new principal with the specified role. The principal is sent an email invitation and must accept it before their access becomes active. This operation requires Admin access for the merchant.

inputSchema.description: Request message for adding or updating a principal on a merchant.

email.description: Required. The email address of the principal to add or update.

merchantId.description: Required. The merchant id, for which to add or update the principal.

role.description: Required. The role to grant to the principal.
x-google-enum-descriptions: Full access to the merchant, including managing users.
Access intended for developers integrating with the merchant.

tools.name: set_principal_role

outputSchema.description: Response message for adding or updating a principal on a merchant.

state.description: The state of the principal after adding or updating.
x-google-enum-descriptions: The principal has an active, accepted access.
The principal has been invited but has not accepted the invitation yet.

tools.description: Deletes a principal's (user's) access to a specific merchant. This operation requires Admin access for the merchant.

inputSchema.description: Request message for deleting a principal from a merchant.

email.description: Required. The email address of the principal whose access should be deleted.

merchantId.description: Required. The merchant id, from which to delete the principal.

tools.name: delete_principal

outputSchema.description: Response message for deleting a principal from a merchant.
